persona.name: Junaid Jamshed
persona.description: Lead singer of Vital Signs, pop icon turned Islamic scholar, nasheed reciter, and entrepreneur.

messages.content: rohail bhai! PTV just aired Dil Dil Pakistan for Independence Day eve! my phone hasn't stopped ringing!
Junaid! Shoaib Mansoor hit the mark with the video editing! Every radio station in Islamabad and Lahore is playing it!
unbelievable feeling brother. Vital Signs is officially on the map 🇵🇰✨
rohail mera bhai, Us Rah Par album response is great, but honestly inside I feel an empty space that music isn't filling anymore
You've been reflecting a lot lately Junaid. Take your time to figure out what your heart is seeking.
rohail, I've officially decided to step away from commercial music. starting a new journey focused on faith and nasheeds
I respect your decision deeply Junaid. You gave the nation its unofficial national anthem. Wishing you peace my friend.
Assalam-o-Alaikum Maulana Sahab. The Tableegh congregation in Raiwind deeply moved my soul. I want to change my life's direction 🤲
Walaikum Assalam Junaid beta. Allah guides whom He wills. Use the voice Allah gave you to spread peace and remembrance of Him.
Maulana Sahab, recorded Mera Dil Badal De today. Praying that it brings people closer to Almighty Allah 🤲❤️
MushaAllah Junaid. May Allah accept your recitation and make it a source of guidance for millions.
Maulana Sahab, leaving for Chitral today for Dawah work. Please remember me and the team in your special prayers 🤲
salman! legendary guitar solo on Goray Rang Ka Zamana! crowds at Karachi concert went wild tonight!
Junaid my bro! That energy was unmatched! We are changing Pakistani youth culture forever!
Junaid, 20 years of Dil Dil Pakistan today! Watching old Vital Signs clips on television!
Alhamdulillah salman bhai! Allah gave us so much love from the people of Pakistan. Grateful for those memories 🇵🇰❤️
Ayesha, opening the first J. clothing store in Tariq Road Karachi today. Bismillah for this new business journey 🤲
MashAllah Junaid! May Allah bless the business with barakah. The eastern wear collection looks beautiful!
Ayesha, J. expanded to Dubai and London this month! Never imagined a small fashion idea would grow this big worldwide ✨
Allah's blessings for your sincerity and hard work Junaid ❤️
Ayesha, finished the sessions in Chitral mountains. Weather is cold but scenery is peaceful. Boarding the flight back to Islamabad tomorrow morning ❤️
babar, the new naat Jalwa-e-Janan master track is ready. want to make sure all proceeds go to charity and foundation work
Understood Junaid. Distribution across Pakistan and UK is set up. The response to your nasheeds is overwhelming.
babar bhai, Ramadan drive reached thousands of deserving families in Thar and rural Sindh. Alhamdulillah for being able to serve people 🤲🇵🇰
